observations.code_quote: A quarantined snapshot reaches the baseline only when a person approves it by identifier, because "Approve all" skips quarantined snapshots.
observations.behavior: Clarifies that quarantine status does not prevent an approved snapshot from reaching the baseline, while bulk approval remains excluded.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help PostHog users maintain accurate visual baselines for stories under quarantine without losing entry tracking.

observations.code_quote: if s.review_state == ReviewState.APPROVED and s.result in (SnapshotResult.NEW, SnapshotResult.CHANGED)
observations.behavior: Removes explicit exclusion of quarantined CHANGED snapshots, allowing them to reach the baseline if approved.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows previously blocked updates to enter the baseline, potentially improving responsiveness to changes on quarantined components.

observations.code_quote: # An explicit approval commits a quarantined snapshot, so its baseline can follow the story.
observations.behavior: Updates test expectations and comments to reflect that both NEW and CHANGED quarantined snapshots are committed upon individual approval.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes behavior is documented and tested; this could support broader use cases where quarantine should not block baseline maintenance.
